title: yosoi::Archive
docs:
One concrete handle to a local `.yosoi` Archive.

The handle owns only an absolute root path. It has no background writer and
holds no files open between operations, so dropping it is sufficient cleanup.

members.title: yosoi::Archive::export_file
members.signature: pub async fn export_file(&self, reference: &yosoi::surface::OutcomeRef, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<(), yosoi::archive::ArchiveError>
members.docs:
Exports one validated Surface outcome as a self-contained portable file.

The file contains a version marker, SHA-256 and exact JSON payload. It
includes retained sources and Plans, never the Archive directory or live
authority. The destination must not exist. Publication is atomic through
a same-directory hard link; filesystems without hard links return an error.
A sync failure after publication reports an error with the file possibly
present. Cancellation can leave a complete file, never a partial destination.

members.title: yosoi::Archive::format_root
members.docs: Returns the current physical format root.

members.title: yosoi::Archive::import_file
members.signature: pub async fn import_file(&self, path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Result<yosoi::surface::OutcomeRef, yosoi::archive::ArchiveError>
members.docs:
Validates a portable file and imports its outcome through normal `write`.

No original directory, source file, browser, decoder or network is used.
Integrity is checked before JSON interpretation, and all outcome limits
are checked before persistence. SHA-256 detects corruption; it does not
authenticate the file's author. Import grants no action permission.

members.title: yosoi::Archive::read_document
members.signature: pub async fn read_document(&self, reference: &yosoi::archive::DocumentArchiveRef) -> Result<yosoi::Document, yosoi::archive::ArchiveError>
members.docs:
Restores and validates one exact SDK Document without network or browser I/O.

Missing records, unsupported versions and corrupt payloads return typed
Archive errors. The result owns its bytes independently of this handle.

members.docs: Writes one supported value and returns its exact typed reference.

members.title: yosoi::Archive::write_document
members.signature: pub async fn write_document(&self, document: &yosoi::Document) -> Result<yosoi::archive::DocumentArchiveRef, yosoi::archive::ArchiveError>
members.docs:
Saves an SDK Document with its exact identity, profile and bytes.

Returns an immutable reference, or an Archive error for unsupported
platforms, unsafe paths, excessive payloads, or failed durable storage.
Cancellation may leave unreferenced staging data; no partial reference is
returned. Repeating a write creates a distinct immutable occurrence.
